title: Potato Practice — Derived Discoveries and Revelations
purpose: Record principles that emerge from repeated application of 'be simple' and 'grow toward light' without turning every discovery into a new first principle.

derivations.name: Efficiency
derivations.insight: Once direction is known, unnecessary motion becomes visible. Efficiency is therefore a consequence of simplicity plus orientation, not an independent commandment.

derivations.name: Wu-wei comparison
derivations.insight: The path naturally approaches unforced action: use the viable direction already present in a situation instead of adding needless force. This is a comparison with Daoist wu wei, not a claim of historical identity.

derivations.name: Carving light into darkness
derivations.insight: Growth need not mean escape. A root and sprout can create a path through difficult conditions, so the practitioner can bring clarity, knowledge, beauty, care or repair into places that were previously opaque.

derivations.name: Fruit test
derivations.insight: A claimed improvement is incomplete until it produces something useful: better understanding, better care, better work, stronger relationships, clearer truth or conditions in which more life can flourish.

derivations.name: Iteration
derivations.insight: Potatoism is not a fixed ladder of achievements. Each cycle returns to simplicity with more information, producing a spiral of refinement rather than a one-time initiation.

derivations.name: Anti-bloat law
derivations.insight: As Potatoism learns more, its practice should become easier to understand and use. If every discovery only adds more rules, the philosophy has contradicted its first principle.

derivations.name: Gardener law
derivations.insight: The mature practitioner increasingly improves conditions rather than forcing outcomes. This connects personal practice to the wider Gardener and stewardship ethic.

derivations.name: Capability-responsibility coupling
derivations.insight: As a person becomes more capable, the expected level of care, discernment and responsibility should increase with that capability.

research_rule: A derived revelation should be promoted only when it can be traced to the root principles, observed across more than one layer of the corpus, and shown to clarify rather than complicate practice.
